messages:
Lina (Palmera): Hey team — heads up: our EU Localization squad will begin a pilot next Tue. Goal: localized product descriptions (ES/FR) across storefront and emails. Expect new endpoints, approx 3x write QPS during content pushes. Need capacity guidance and a rollout plan.

Maya (CSM): Thanks Lina — can you share expected peak rps, avg tokens per call, streaming vs sync, and whether later test will need larger models? I'll open CS ticket and book enablement.

Lina (Palmera): Peak ~1600-2000 rps cluster-wide for short windows, avg ~110 tokens, mostly sync; a few endpoints will stream for live preview. Pilot uses redwood-clarity-13b; plan to evaluate 70B for quality after pilot. No PII.

Ethan (Solutions): With those numbers we can tune prefix cache + batching. Suggest starting hosted with short Dedicated reserve during pilot windows. Monitor p95 latency and token cost delta.

Jordan (Eng-Infra): Agree. Quick notes: 13B is fine on hosted burst if autoscale is aggressive; 70B needs warm Dedicated hosts or reserved capacity to avoid cold-start latency. We'll prepare a fallback policy (70B -> 13B) with a telemetry flag for degraded quality.

Maya (CSM): Booking enablement session: Thu 2026-03-27 09:00 PT. Adding to expansion tracker as an "expansion-signal" and creating CS ticket. autoscale-bot: please create ticket.

autoscale-bot: ticket CS-4689 created and assigned to Eng-Infra.

Ethan (Solutions): Draft autoscale config for the pilot route: auto_scale min_hosts=2 max_hosts=8 target_latency_ms=140 batching max_batch_tokens=4096 prefer_prefix_cache=true. We'll push this as a canary and adjust.

Lina (Palmera): We'll upload a sample prompt set + golden outputs to the shared Palmera folder by EOD. Also noting renewal: annual renewal Q3; expansion is positive but keep an eye on cost vs forecast so we can surface any renewal risk.

Maya (CSM): Noted. We'll wire those prompts into regression alerts and QA evals. Also recommend a short cost forecast after pilot to show delta to product team.

Jordan (Eng-Infra): Follow-up: Eng-Infra will provision a 48-hour Dedicated warm window for the final pilot week to test 70B if requested. We'll post details in the ticket.

Lina (Palmera): Excellent — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
